tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Searches active NYC rental listings from StreetEasy, LeaseBreak, NYBits, Reddit, and building websites, plus lease takeovers posted on Buzzedin. Supports price, bedrooms, neighborhoods, boroughs, move-in dates, commute time to an address, distance to places (subway, grocery, a named store), amenitie

tools.name: create_alert_link
tools.description: Create a link that opens this search on Buzzedin, where the user can save it as an alert and get an email or push notification when a new matching listing appears. Pass the same filters used for search_listings. Use it when the user wants to be notified, or accepts the offer of an alert.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_alert_link · Public sink: create_alert_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_alert_link · Public sink: create_alert_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
